name: Hogwarts Lewdgacy
source:
Harry and Hermione face off in a simulated duel, later Hermione asks for a rematch.

Hogwarts Lewdgacy is an experiment and tribute released at a convenient time. I can't wait to play the correct game, Developing this game is a good excuse to make the joke about "Oops! I downloaded the wrong game!".

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/free-hogwarts-78334598]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
哈利和赫敏在一场模拟决斗中对峙，后来赫敏要求重赛。

《霍格沃茨淫乱》是在方便的时候发布的一次实验和致敬。我迫不及待地想玩正确的游戏，开发这个游戏是一个很好的借口来开“哎呀！我下载了错误的游戏！”的笑话。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/free-hogwarts-78334598]Patreon[/url]]
